annotations.title: Run the words and the photo of a starter site again

description: After SHIP publishes a starter site from the founder's answers, a text model writes the words of the page and an image model makes the photo at the top, and SHIP adds them in a second commit. When that failed (firstSiteWords.state is failed on get_site), this runs it once more. A job has three runs in all. The answer is the job's new state; follow it with get_site. Requires the config:write capability.
name: retry_first_site_words
title: Run the words and the photo of a starter site again
